messages.author: d6bd4cfc4307a897
messages.subject: Connecting to third-party-hosted database
parts:
Hi,

In spark.rstudio.com, I was able to use FreeTDS driver to connect to a SQL Server on a third-party-hosted server. However, I am not able to do that with shinyapps.io . Is FreeTDS not supported? The following is the connection string that I've used successfully in spark:

'Driver=FreeTDS;TDS_Version=7.2;Server=<myserver>;port=1433;Database=<mydatabase>;UID=<myuserid>;Pwd=<mypassword>'

Thanks.
